name: claim-center
description: Claim Center clean rewrite on Cloudflare Workers + D1 with Claim_Data A:AQ contract

scripts.check: node --check worker/main.js && node --check worker/contract-entry.js && node --check site/app-core.js && node --check site/app-contract.js && node --check site/ux-runtime.js && node --check site/app.js
scripts.test: node -e "import('./worker/contract-entry.js').then(m=>{if(m.CLAIM_HEADERS.length!==43)throw new Error('Claim contract must be 43 columns');if(m.CLAIM_HEADERS[1]!=='Store Name (Thai)'||m.CLAIM_HEADERS[20]!=='Ship Date'||m.CLAIM_HEADERS[31]!=='Format Type'||m.CLAIM_HEADERS[42]!=='Year')throw new Error('Claim contract positions changed');console.log('A:AQ contract ok')})" && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const h=fs.readFileSync('site/index.html','utf8');for(const v of ['RunValidation','data-page=\"validation\"','data-theme-choice','Master Article — Weekly Replace'])if(!h.includes(v))throw new Error('Missing clean UI contract: '+v);if(h.includes('Pivot Table'))throw new Error('Pivot Table must not exist');console.log('UI contract ok')" && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const u=fs.readFileSync('site/ux-runtime.js','utf8');for(const v of ['cancelClaim','beforeunload','กำลังบันทึก','ux-invalid'])if(!u.includes(v))throw new Error('Missing UX safeguard: '+v);console.log('workflow UX contract ok')"
